changelog_html:
1.4.1 (2026-11-25)

Status check now reports the newest available version, so Wren can flag sites that are behind. First release delivered through the WordPress update notice.

1.4.0 (2026-11-25)

Self-updating from GitHub. Clears Elementor and SiteGround caches when Wren saves a page or a page is published or unpublished. Refresh endpoint. Exposes Elementor and Yoast fields for Wren.
